title: M11 — Secrets at Scale — Baseline
description: Tour a healthy secrets pipeline on the Polyphone fleet: a backing store (vault-backend) standing in for an external secrets manager, SecretSync objects that model ESO ExternalSecrets, the secret-operator reconcile loop that materializes a Kubernetes Secret for each, and the consumers running on those materialized Secrets.

steps.title: The pipeline inputs: store and SecretSyncs
The materialized Secret: a derived object
The operator reconciling: reading sync status
The consumer: the chain end to end
